# Kenney Input Prompts (Xbox Series buttons)

Four pictures from [Input Prompts](https://kenney.nl/assets/input-prompts) by [Kenney](https://www.kenney.nl), version 1.1,
CC0 (public domain, see `LICENSE.txt`): `xbox_button_color_a.png`, `_b`, `_x` and `_y` (64x64, from `Xbox Series/Default/`), unmodified.

Copied from the pack's mirror at https://github.com/tanuki-billie/kenney-input-prompts, commit `49f37cc4e74fa661382f9752567924a8109b6568`.

Used by `dm/android/tools/prompts.py` to draw Xbox button prompts over the game's Switch button pictures (see the README's Playing section).
